title: Jeju Three-Day Itinerary: The Easy Coast-by-Coast Plan
summary: Plan three days in Jeju by exploring the west coast, east coast, and either Hallasan or the south. Get practical tips on transport, Udo ferries, and where to stay.

slides.title: Three Days, Three Areas
slides.sub: Do west, east, then Hallasan or the south
slides.voice: Three days in Jeju? Do west, east, then Hallasan or the south.

slides.title: A Car Saves Time
slides.sub: Bring your passport and accepted license
slides.voice: A car saves time. Bring your passport and accepted license or International Driving Permit.

slides.title: Base Yourself in Jeju City
slides.sub: Maison GLAD Jeju is a convenient city base
slides.voice: Maison GLAD Jeju is a convenient city base.

slides.title: Walk Hyeopjae Beach
slides.sub: Explore the sand and coastal path

slides.title: Go Early to Sunrise Peak
slides.sub: Beat the tour groups at Seongsan Ilchulbong
slides.voice: Go early to Seongsan Ilchulbong to avoid tour groups.

slides.title: Check Udo Ferries
slides.sub: Wind can cancel sailings; check that day
slides.voice: Udo ferries can be cancelled in strong wind. Check on the day.

slides.voice: Hallasan summit trails need advance online reservations; Eoseungsaengak is shorter.

slides.title: Finish at the South Coast
